headline: A 2021 law requires USAID to give Pakistani women at least half of the scholarships under one of its Pakistan programs for calendar years 2020 through 2022.
what_it_does: The law directs the U.S. Agency for International Development to award at least 50% of the scholarships under its Merit and Needs-Based Scholarship Program to Pakistani women. The requirement covers each calendar year from 2020 through 2022. The summary does not describe the program's total size, eligibility rules, or how the agency must report results.

who_it_affects.group: Pakistani women seeking scholarships under the Merit and Needs-Based Scholarship Program
who_it_affects.how: They are guaranteed that at least half of the awarded scholarships in each covered year go to women.

who_it_affects.group: Pakistani men and others seeking scholarships under the Merit and Needs-Based Scholarship Program
who_it_affects.how: Scholarships available to them in each covered year may be fewer because half must go to women.
The agency must meet the 50% women's share when it awards these scholarships in 2020, 2021, and 2022.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 13, 2021, and applies to scholarships awarded for calendar years 2020 through 2022.
